author: Y Combinator
description:
Software is cheap to start. Robots, GPU clusters, and data centers are not.

The physical AI buildout will need new ways to finance steel and silicon: lenders, leasing companies, securitization, and hedging products designed around machines and compute. Every great infrastructure boom created financial giants alongside it.

Apply for the Winter 2027 batch at ycombinator.com/apply.
title: Wall Street for the Physical Buildout

author: Y Combinator
description:
Most companies building with AI still rent their intelligence from frontier labs.

As open models improve, more companies will want models they can run, train, and control themselves. The opportunity is to turn a company’s workflows, expertise, and failures into specialized models that improve with the business.

Apply for the Winter 2027 batch at ycombinator.com/apply.
title: Own Your Intelligence

author: Y Combinator
description:
Applying for government benefits means proving the same facts again and again across systems that don’t talk to each other. That creates friction for honest applicants and openings for fraud.

Government needs a Plaid-like layer for verified income, tax, and residency data: verify once, apply everywhere. As AI agents begin handling enrollment, trusted data infrastructure becomes even more important.

Apply for the Winter 2027 batch at ycombinator.com/apply.
title: Plaid for Government Benefits

author: Y Combinator
description:
The AI data center buildout is creating shortages far beyond GPUs and power. Transformers take years to get, while switchgear, circuit breakers, cooling systems, and specialized steel are all becoming bottlenecks.

A buildout this large creates startup opportunities throughout the supply chain, especially in the overlooked parts nobody talks about yet.

Apply for the Winter 2027 batch at ycombinator.com/apply.
title: Data Center Supply Chain
